 ‘JASON’ – 13th Official Movie Will Release in Theaters August 13, 2027 from Cineverse
 John Squires 
 November 18, 2026 
 Share 
 Facebook 
 X 
 Reddit 
 Bluesky 
 Threads 
 WhatsApp 
 Copy link 
 'Sweet Revenge' 
 Jason Voorhees is finally headed back to the big screen in a brand new 13th feature film, and Bloody Disgusting’s parent company Cineverse will unleash the film in theaters August 13, 2027 .
 Titled JASON , the brand new movie will be directed by franchise legacy director Steve Miner , who first put the machete in Jason’s hands back in the 1980s in Friday the 13th Part II and soon thereafter introduced the legendary hockey mask in sequel Friday the 13th Part III . Cineverse has secured the upcoming movie’s North America distribution rights, including theatrical.
 Jason was shot independently and in secret, with production wrapping today.
 Schuyler White , who played Jason in the Jason Universe short film Sweet Revenge, will be playing Jason in the new movie, with Natalie Alyn Lind starring as main character Lauren.
 Producer Robbie Barsamian previews, “We spent months thinking about how to create the scariest, most imposing Jason and who truly deserved to wear the mask. Beyond his towering physical presence, we knew Schuyler understood what makes Jason tick—and that he had the work ethic and genuine respect for this franchise to get it right. He approached this theatrical feature like the role of a lifetime, packing 30 pounds of solid muscle onto his 6’5″ frame and studying the iconic Jasons who came before him so that he feels like an unstoppable force of nature. On set, we framed him low and tight, so the audience is right there in his space, looking up at him.
 “This will be the most intimidating Jason that has ever been on screen .”
 “Natalie Alyn Lind is not only an excellent actress and incredibly hardworking, but also one of the biggest horror enthusiasts and fans of this franchise,” Barsamian continues. “When you put all that together you get something special. This franchise has had many strong female leads, but her performance might just be the strongest this franchise has ever had.”
 The new movie’s cast also includes Matt Cornett ( Every Year After ) as Asher, Lilia Buckingham ( Hocus Pocus 2 ) as Madison, John Owen Lowe ( Unstable ) as Jake, Summer Madison ( The Summer I Turned Pretty ) as Emily, Selena Turner ( Will Trent ) as Olive, Matthew Keoni Sato ( High School Musical: The Musical: The Series ) as Lucas, Brook Sill ( Stranger Things ) as Zoe, Guillermo Diaz ( Scandal ) as Rick, Johnell Young ( Wu-Tang: An American Saga ) as Frank, Sencere Messiah Brown ( Homage ) as Chase and Bryan Gael Guzman ( Nickel Boys ) as Dylan.
 The screenplay for JASON was written by emerging screenwriter David Fliegel .
 Returning to the franchise’s independent roots, the upcoming Jason Voorhees feature film is financed and produced by the Barsamians. CatchLight Studios is the production partner.
 “For millions of fans worldwide, Jason is the absolute king of slasher horror,” said Robbie Barsamian, Executive Vice President of Horror, Inc. “Financing and producing this film independently gave us complete creative freedom, allowing us to protect what makes this franchise special and deliver the big-screen terror our fans have been dying for. When we started putting our team together, we were looking for talented people that had a deep love for this franchise and were willing to go above and beyond to make the best movie.”
 Cineverse will unleash JASON in theaters nationwide on August 13, 2027.
